bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $35.4，收盘创去年 12月以来新低

read.en: AAOI fell 16.5% on Nov 20 to $32.93, its lowest close since Dec 19, 2025, trading $32.62–37.69. It is below the 5-day ($40.71), 10-day ($46.26), 30-day ($64.55), 100-day ($97.93) and 200-day ($114.94), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 16 ($54.81), and RSI is 26.2, oversold.
read.zh: AAOI 11月20日下跌 16.5%，收于 $32.93，为 2025年12月19日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $32.62–37.69。股价位于 5 日（$40.71）、10 日（$46.26）、30 日（$64.55）、100 日（$97.93）和 200 日均线（$114.94）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月16日起看空（$54.81），RSI 为 26.2，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke both written supports, $37.0–37.6 (Nov 18 and Feb 5 lows) and $35.4–35.7 (January lows), now resistance. Resistance is $34.5–35.7, then $37.0–37.7 (Nov 20 high) and $39.5–40.8. Support is $31.3–31.7 (Jan 8 and December 2024 lows), then $30. A close above $37.7 would target $39.5–40.8; below $31.3, $30.
